items.reasons: The round top ring is scattered with bright yellow-orange single-pixel dots that read as sticker sparkles, not shading. The hanging garments are a dense blue mass with no clear dark outer outline like the originals, so the silhouette is noisy and the edges are soft.

The shelf is drawn as a flat front elevation: the top plank shows only a 1–2 px sliver with no lit top plane, and the microwave and rice cooker are also shown straight-on. At 1 tile wide and 2 tall it looks narrow and toy-sized next to the wardrobe and cooler.

The frame is a front-on rectangle of rails with no visible top plane or depth to the drying bars. The red garment in the middle is a muddy dark-red clump that merges with the green and blue pieces, and the clothes lack the dark outline weight of the originals.

The umbrellas are lumpy red, blue and grey figure-like blobs that run up to the top edge of the canvas. At 1x they read as little people or bottles in a bin, not furled umbrellas, and the stand's opening isn't shown as a top-down rim.

It is a pure front elevation of a tall green panel, with no top rail or plane seen from above and a flat-on base. At 1x it reads as a locker or door rather than a curtain screen on a frame, and the dark bottom corner blocks look detached from the frame.
